events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commits, stack state and reports
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -8 -- app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs; git branch --contains a1c8b18a 2>&1 | head -3; git status -sb | head -2; git log origin/main..main --oneline | head; ls /tmp/t242c/ 2>&1 | head -30; for p in 8970 8972 8974; do echo -n "$p: "; lsof -ti:$p | head -1; echo; done; ls /tmp/walk/ | grep 242
